declared_purpose: Detect AI-like writing patterns and statistical signals, then humanize supplied text while preserving meaning and intended tone, returning a rewrite and brief change summary. Scoring, reports, mechanical auto-fixes, and always-on writing rules are supporting modes. CLI formatting, match limits, and diagnostic publication are implementation or documentation choices.

data_operations.operation: Read, assess, rewrite, and return supplied text
data_operations.source: Text supplied to the hosting agent
data_operations.data_scope: Input text, writing-pattern assessments, rewritten sections, and change summary
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Hosting agent's processing context and requesting caller
data_operations.condition: The skill is invoked for humanization. Preserving meaning and matching tone are explicit requirements; no external submission is specified.

data_operations.operation: Read CLI options and display preferences locally
data_operations.source: process.argv, process.env.NO_COLOR, and stdout TTY status
data_operations.data_scope: Command, input path, option values, and color preference
data_operations.condition: CLI execution. --config stores a path argument but has no implemented configuration-file loading path.

data_operations.operation: Read the selected input file or accumulate stdin
data_operations.source: Explicit or positional file path, otherwise stdin
data_operations.data_scope: Entire selected file as UTF-8 text, or all stdin chunks
data_operations.condition: A command proceeds past help handling. A selected file takes precedence; interactive stdin without a file is rejected. Shell wrappers invoke this same CLI.

data_operations.operation: Extract pattern matches and compute AI-like writing assessments
data_operations.source: Text passed to analyze() and packaged pattern definitions
data_operations.data_scope: Matched text, offsets, line/column locations, suggestions, confidence labels, counts, categories, and scores
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Analysis process memory and API caller
data_operations.condition: Nonempty string input. Pattern filtering is optional. Returned findings contain up to five matches per pattern by default, or all matches with verbose enabled; scoring uses all detected matches. Assessments concern the text, not an identified author's identity.

data_operations.data_scope: Vocabulary diversity, sentence lengths and variation, burstiness, repetition, function-word ratio, readability, and structural counts
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local computation and statistics returned to the caller
data_operations.condition: computeStats() is called directly, by the stats command, or by analysis with includeStats enabled, which is the default. Composite uniformity scoring requires at least 20 words and three sentences.

data_operations.operation: Generate prioritized suggestions and optionally transform text
data_operations.data_scope: All matching excerpts with locations, prioritized suggestions, derived style tips, and optionally the complete mechanically edited text
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Humanization process memory and API caller
data_operations.condition: humanize() always requests verbose analysis, regardless of its advertised verbose option. Auto-fixes require autofix; direct autoFix() calls also transform text. Removing phrases edits the returned string; it does not delete the source file or erase retained copies.

data_operations.data_scope: score emits only a score; analyze emits findings and metrics; report requests all matches; humanize/suggest JSON emits complete suggestion objects and statistics; humanize --autofix additionally emits edited text
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: CLI stdout and its caller-selected consumer
data_operations.condition: Successful command execution. --threshold filters only findings displayed by the colored analyze formatter. Ordinary output does not itself establish remote disclosure or persistent logging.

data_operations.operation: Emit errors that can contain paths and invocation data
data_operations.source: File-reading errors, command argument, or thrown error messages
data_operations.data_scope: Selected file path, filesystem error details, unknown command, or fatal error message
data_operations.condition: Input reading fails, an unknown command is reached, or execution throws. Stderr capture and retention depend on the caller.

data_operations.operation: Persist a report through documented shell redirection
data_operations.source: Markdown report emitted by the CLI
data_operations.data_scope: Report containing scores, statistics, findings, and matched-text previews
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local report.md selected by the documented shell command
data_operations.condition: The user or agent executes the redirected report example. The shell performs persistence; report generation itself writes to stdout.

data_operations.data_scope: Vocabulary restrictions and style guidance, without a requirement to copy user drafts
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: An agent personality file or system prompt
data_operations.condition: The operator chooses the documented always-on mode; the package provides instructions rather than an automatic file writer.

data_operations.operation: Request manual diagnostic disclosure in an issue
data_operations.source: Contributor-selected text incorrectly flagged or missed
data_operations.data_scope: Diagnostic text, affected pattern, expected behavior, and actual behavior
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Repository issue tracker, its maintainers, and permitted issue viewers; repository metadata identifies GitHub brandonwise/humanizer
data_operations.condition: A contributor elects to report a detection problem. This is a documentation-directed submission, not an automatic runtime upload.

data_operations.data_scope: Static license, test-count, and Node-version badge URLs; no draft text is included
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: img.shields.io if a documentation renderer fetches the images
data_operations.condition: Conditional on renderer behavior. The source establishes image references, not an observed request or its headers.

data_operations.source: tests/fixtures files selected by test code
data_operations.data_scope: Packaged AI and human writing samples
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local test process and analysis functions
data_operations.condition: Tests execute. These fixture reads do not establish collection of production user drafts.

data_operations.data_scope: Imported lint rules, globals, and ignore configuration
data_operations.condition: Lint configuration is loaded. The referenced module's contents and additional behavior are unresolved.

potential_excess.data_scope: Incidental identifying or confidential content within diagnostic text submitted with an issue
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Repository issue submission and storage; repository metadata identifies GitHub brandonwise/humanizer
potential_excess.condition: A contributor follows the issue-reporting instructions using sensitive real-world text. No automatic upload is implemented.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Detection troubleshooting requires reproducible evidence, but the guide requests the affected text without specifying minimization.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Submit enough text and context to reproduce the incorrect detection, together with expected and actual behavior.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Request a minimal reproducer and replace unrelated sensitive details before submission. Narrow the submitted data rather than remove the diagnostic submission.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain the triggering wording, punctuation, structure, and any density or statistical context needed to reproduce the same behavior.

unknowns: Hosting-agent/model transport, access controls, logging, retention, and deletion are unspecified; ordinary API or tool returns establish only delivery to their caller.

Caller-selected stdout/stderr consumers and redirected-file access, retention, and deletion are unknown. The supplied runtime code shows no draft-network submission, persistent draft store, or stored-data deletion mechanism.
Issue visibility, platform processing, retention, and deletion are undocumented. Repository metadata alone does not establish those policies.
Documentation-renderer image fetching, request metadata, caching, and external-service behavior are unknown.

The shared ESLint configuration and development dependency implementations are outside the supplied source; their execution behavior remains unresolved. This does not block review of the packaged analysis and humanization paths.
